cards.meaning: falling short, not enough -- lacking what's needed
cards.example: Kapos sa tauhan ang COA -- kulang sila ng 384 na awditor.
cards.exampleMeaning: The COA is short-staffed -- they're lacking 384 auditors.
cards.note: A casual, everyday-register word for a shortfall -- money, time, staff, whatever's not enough. Distinct from the more formal 'kakapusan,' which sounds like a report describing a standing condition; 'kapos' is what you'd say to a friend when something just doesn't stretch far enough.
cards.tiesTo: COA admits it's short 384 auditors, undercutting oversight of the flood-control-scandal infrastructure budget

cards.meaning: close monitoring, surveillance -- deliberate, targeted watching
cards.example: 107 opisyal ng gobyerno ang sinasailalim sa pagmamanman ng Ombudsman.
cards.exampleMeaning: 107 government officials are being subjected to the Ombudsman's lifestyle-check monitoring.
cards.note: A formal, journalistic-register word built on the root 'manman' (to watch closely, without looking away) -- used when an institution or authority is deliberately watching a specific person or group, not casual observation. Carries more weight than 'pagbabantay,' which is neutral enough to describe watching a child or a pet.
cards.tiesTo: Ombudsman puts 107 officials under lifestyle checks, focused on LTO and Customs

cards.meaning: it's not actually X -- it's really Y -- corrects a false impression
cards.example: 工业利润的回升并非内需真正好转，而是人工智能产业链价格上涨所致。
cards.examplePinyin: gōng yè lì rùn de huí shēng bìng fēi nèi xū zhēn zhèng hǎo zhuǎn, ér shì rén gōng zhì néng chǎn yè liàn jià gé shàng zhǎng suǒ zhì
cards.exampleMeaning: The pickup in industrial profit isn't really domestic demand recovering -- it's the AI supply chain's price surge that's doing it.
cards.note: 书面语 (formal register), the analyst's connective -- distinct from plain 不是…而是…, which neutrally states a substitution. 并非 carries an argumentative edge: you're specifically correcting a false impression someone might reasonably hold, which is why it fits business and data journalism so naturally.
cards.tiesTo: China's July industrial-profit growth cools to a 7-month low even as AI-linked electronics profits triple-digit

cards.example: 电子行业与传统制造业的利润出现明显分化。
cards.examplePinyin: diàn zǐ háng yè yǔ chuán tǒng zhì zào yè de lì rùn chū xiàn míng xiǎn fēn huà
cards.exampleMeaning: Profit performance has clearly diverged between electronics and traditional manufacturing.
cards.note: 书面语 (formal, financial-register), an abstract verb that collocates with 行业 (an industry) or 效益 (performance) -- carries a sense of things that used to move together now drifting apart. A near-synonym of 分裂 (fēnliè), which implies an actual rupture or break; 分化 is softer and gradual, no break required.
cards.tiesTo: China's industrial-profit release showing electronics/AI-linked sectors soaring while traditional manufacturing keeps getting squeezed by price wars
